'''Solis Tavern''', often referred to as just '''Solis''', is a restaurant run by [[Fulvia]]. 

==Shop==
{{Vendor|Fulvia}} 

==Descriptions==
{{Description|The hottest restaurant in Septimont City. Here, you can order a hearty Glory Set, sip on a glass of wheat juice, or even get up and dance while watching a match broadcast. At Solis, there's always a place for you.}}
